recovery_notes: Capture the exact OxygenOS build/fingerprint and stock recovery path before device writes.
Prefer temporary fastboot boot; persistent tests must target only the inactive A/B slot.
The engineering first-boot kernel disables automatic module signing so builds do not embed an ephemeral random certificate; Stable must define a reviewed signing policy before release.
The engineering first-boot kernel requires CONFIG_RD_LZ4=y because the profile boot policy uses an LZ4 ramdisk.

The host reproducibility profile exports deterministic GNU tar metadata/order and single-threaded xz settings for CONFIG_IKHEADERS generation; this is build-only evidence and does not grant hardware support.

The compat-vDSO reproducibility experiment passes canonical debug/macro prefix maps through the locked clang CC command using recursive KBUILD_SRC/CURDIR make variables because the pinned vdso32 Makefile intentionally does not inherit global KBUILD CFLAGS; this is host-only evidence and does not grant hardware support.

The device-tree host contract builds dtbs from the exact reviewed kernel source/config/toolchain and expects the profile-selected lito.dtb plus avicii-overlay.dtbo before creating a deterministic Android DT table image; this does not prove physical device-tree functionality.

The rootfs handoff contract is discovery-only: the pinned Lineage fstab reports encrypted/wrapped-key userdata on UFS, so no raw block path or staging target is selected before exact-device storage/encryption/free-space/recovery evidence is reviewed.

Physical storage discovery records kernel names and partition roles only, binds exact report/recovery-plan bytes to the rescue/rootfs evidence chain, and still cannot select a target or authorize a write.
Do not mark recovery verified until restore has been exercised on the exact physical AC2003 baseline.

deterministic CONFIG_IKHEADERS tar/xz archive environment is profile-bound
compat-vDSO clang command carries canonical source/output path maps through recursive make variables
source-locked compiler kernel build and two-build reproducibility verification
profile-driven DTB/DTBO output selection and strict A/B artifact reproducibility verification
discovery-only rootfs handoff policy is source-pinned, forbids system/A-B targets, and cannot authorize storage writes
typed physical storage discovery evidence cross-binds rescue topology and rootfs handoff identities without expressing a target path or hardware/Beta claim
profile-driven functional hardware test plan is fail-closed, pending-only and cannot authorize destructive or persistent-write tests

observed USB behavior is manually reviewed against the exact physical transcript

Bluetooth functionality is physically exercised under Kali userspace and manually reviewed
audio output or capture is physically exercised under Kali userspace and manually reviewed
